decisions.statement: The path is handed in and the body is not.
The body landed is the body the tree holds at that path when the edits land.
A body of any bytes lands this way, because no argument spells that body.
A path the tree holds no body at is refused.
The checks judge the tree the edits leave.
This change works no body out, so this change reaches no mechanical change.

definition: one body the tree already holds, landed at the path that body sits at
